summary_en: Japan Post Bank executed acquisition of 9.44 million shares at 3,177 yen per share on November 17, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading, with total acquisition amount capped at approximately 30.0 billion yen, representing 0.3% of issued shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 17, 2026, Japan Post Bank executed acquisition of treasury stock via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading at 3,177 yen per share. The total acquisition amount was capped at approximately 30.0 billion yen for up to 9.44 million shares, representing 0.3% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The trading took place during the morning session on November 17 at the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with acquisition results to be disclosed after the trading session ended.

This execution represented partial fulfillment of a 30.0 billion yen acquisition authorization approved by the board of directors on November 13, 2026. Japan Post Company, which holds approximately 49.9% voting rights in Japan Post Bank, sold 4.72 million shares in conjunction with this acquisition. Any remaining portion of the authorized amount would be acquired through market purchases starting November 18, 2026, subject to the constraint that Japan Post Company's voting rights be maintained at or below the current level of approximately 49.9%.
